entities.summary: Habsburg Rule & the Dutch Revolt, a transformative movement in Belgium (1477–1598). Emerged from Burgundian Golden Age. Catalyzed Iconoclastic Fury sweeps the Low Countries and Union of Arras – southern provinces remain under Spain.
